[01:09.84] Thinkin' 'bout you and me, fluently

[01:41.92] This is the part where I confess that most of my relations were toxic
[01:47.26] Happiness will come when it's ready
[01:50.08] Hold out your hands and embrace it with open arms
[01:52.98] This is the part where I confess that toxic humans come off attractive
[01:58.74] I made this song for anyone that's going through it, I'll clean up the mess
